title: docs(skills,console): record why the seven sectioning tags stay off the curated tier; retract the section row (objectui#8775)
body:
Fixes #8775
Clause-②: no — the ruling records a reason in a test ledger and retracts a teaching line; `PUBLIC_BLOCKS`, the manifest and every published type are byte-unchanged (ruling execution parameter 4)
Ruling: 5857078807 (B)

Dispatched by the `domain:ui` seat 2 (claim 5859939443). Implemented by the `os-dev` subagent of session `https://claude.ai/code/session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`.

## What changed

1. **Console ledger.** In `apps/console/src/__tests__/public-contract.test.ts`, `SECTIONING_TAG_UNRULED` becomes `SECTIONING_TAG_REFUSED`, which carries the ruled reason. The rename follows the file's own convention: the `aspect-ratio` entry beside it opens `'RULED: refused on stated merits (objectui#8628, ruling 5634038424, letter B, ratified 5810240972). '`, so this one opens `'RULED: refused on stated merits (objectui#8775, ruling 5857078807, letter B). '`. The ledger docblock no longer says objectui#8775 "holds the decision". Nothing in the tree asserts the ledger's text; the pins over it (population equals ledger keys, a `#NNN` per entry, more than 40 characters, no stale entry) keep their assertions.
2. **Published skill guide.** `skills/objectui/guides/page-builder.md`, section "3b. Pick the right layout primitive": the `section` row is retracted. The prose that said `box` and `section` exist for the same reason now covers `box` alone. It points an author who needs a landmark on a JSON page to `page:section` / `page:footer` / `page:sidebar` / `page:header`, and says what each one renders.
3. **Docs.** `content/docs/components/layout/semantic.mdx` stops teaching `body?: SchemaNode[]; // Alternative content prop`, which objectui#6771 retired. It now states that `children` is the one child-list key, as the renderer and the schema read today. Prose only.
4. **Changeset.** `.changeset/8775-sectioning-tags-ruled-reason.md`, with empty frontmatter, releases nothing. The presence gate asked for it, because `apps/console/src/**` is released source of `@object-ui/console`.

`container-declaration-census.test.tsx` is **unchanged**. Its premise text names neither `SECTIONING_TAG_UNRULED` nor `UNCURATED_LAYOUT_CONTAINERS` nor objectui#8775 (grep: 0 hits), and it still reads true: "The seven sectioning tags are declared for the html tier and nowhere else". `semantic.tsx`'s registration comment is also unchanged and still true.

## The reason, sentence by sentence, and the reading behind each one

### (a) Zero pull in real apps

The subject grep is a JSON `type` literal of one of the seven: `(type|"type")\s*:\s*["'](article|aside|footer|header|main|nav|section)["']`. The control is the same grep shape over each corpus's ordinary layout blocks.

| corpus | subject | control |
|---|---|---|
| objectstack `examples/` at `origin/main` `4e0f72e8d2` (showcase, crm, todo, multi-package, embed) | **0** (`git grep` exit 1) | `box`/`flex`/`card`: 15 lines, in `command-center.page.ts` (8) and `styling-gallery.page.ts` (7) |
| hotcrm `2f7b232` (depth-1 clone; the same head the ruling read) | **0** (exit 1) | `grid`/`page:header`/`page:card`: 50 lines in 21 files (hotcrm authors no `box`/`flex`/`card` at all, so that control would read 0) |
| objectui `examples/` outside `examples/schema-catalog` | **0** | `box`/`flex`/`card`: 1 (`hello-world/schema.json`, `card`) |
| objectui `examples/schema-catalog` | 17 lines, all in `components-layout-semantic/` (9 fixtures) | the catalogue documents its own renderers, the same class as `components-layout-aspect-ratio/` |

- The seven appear as JSX only in two objectstack showcase pages. `crm-workbench.page.ts` (3 lines) and `task-desk.page.ts` (1 line) are both `kind: 'react'`, so those hits are DOM intrinsics. The three `kind: 'html'` showcase pages (`capability-map`, `command-center-jsx`, `start-here`) use none of the seven.
- hotcrm's only JSX-shaped hit under `src/` is a prose comment in `home.page.ts`.

### (b) The seven are html-tier intrinsics that render on `kind:'html'` pages

This reading comes from a one-off probe, run once under the verify lock and deleted, never committed. It used the full console registration graph, the same imports as `html-tier-code-element-10756.test.tsx`.

```text
b.inHtmlTierIntrinsics [["article",true],["aside",true],["footer",true],["header",true],["main",true],["nav",true],["section",true]]
b.inPublicBlocks []
b.publicConfigTier [["article","html"],["aside","html"],["footer","html"],["header","html"],["main","html"],["nav","html"],["section","html"]]
b.compileDiagnostics []                      (all seven in one kind:'html' source, against the live page manifest)
b.htmlPageRendered [["article","A"],["aside","AS"],["footer","F"],["header","H"],["main","H"],["nav","N"],["section","S"]]
b.control.h1Absent true                      (a tag not on the page is absent: the reader is live)
```

The tier half is re-derived by the census pin "none of the eight is in the curated public contract". The render half is this one-time reading, and the ledger text says so, per AGENTS.md commandment 9.

### (c) The curated tier already carries the landmarks, one spelling each

This reading comes from the same probe.

```text
c.inPublicBlocks [["page:section",true],["page:header",true],["page:footer",true],["page:sidebar",true]]
c.render.page:section {"tag":"section","className":"space-y-4","text":"kid"}
c.render.page:footer  {"tag":"footer","className":"flex items-center justify-between text-sm text-muted-foreground","text":"kid"}
c.render.page:sidebar {"tag":"aside","className":"flex flex-col gap-4 w-full md:w-80 shrink-0","text":"kid"}
c.render.page:header  {"tag":"header","h1":"T"}
c.page:header.inputs  ["title","subtitle","actions","breadcrumb","recordChrome","showStar","showCopyId","maxVisible","mobileMaxVisible"]
c.page:header.isContainer null
```

- ⇒ `page:header` is the page's title row, and it declares no child slot. The guide therefore says it "takes no `children`" rather than calling it a container.
- `page:footer` also renders a separator above its `footer` element.
- All four blocks are in `EXPECTED_COVERED` in the same test file.

### (d) Curating any of the seven adds a near-synonym pair

```text
d.render.bare-section {"tag":"section","className":null,"text":"kid"}   vs   page:section {"tag":"section","className":"space-y-4",...}
```

- The factory in `semantic.tsx` passes `className` through verbatim, exactly as `box` does.
- The retracted guide row said so itself: "none — `className` passes through **verbatim**, exactly like `box`".
- So each of the seven is `box` with a different element. For four of them there is also a curated `page:*` block that renders the same element.
- `main`, `nav` and `article` have no `page:*` twin. The ledger therefore states the pair through `box` for all seven, and through `page:*` for four. That is narrower than the first draft of the text, and it is true for all seven.

### `semantic.mdx`: what the renderer and the schema read now

This reading comes from the same probe.

```text
mdx.section.children "VIA_CHILDREN"        mdx.section.body {"el":true,"text":""}
mdx.main.children    "VIA_CHILDREN"        mdx.main.body    {"el":true,"text":""}
mdx.semantic.inputs  ["className:string","children:slot"]
mdx.zod.children     true
mdx.zod.body         ["invalid_type:body:Unrecognized key(s) on this node: `body`. Did you mean `body` → `children`? The `body` child-list spelling was retired by objectui#6771 — ..."]
```

## Parameter 6: other teaching of the seven as JSON blocks

The grep is the subject pattern above, over `skills/`, `content/` and `.changeset/`, plus a backticked `` `section` `` in `skills/`.

- `skills/objectui/guides/page-builder.md`: the row and the prose. **Corrected here.**
- `content/docs/components/layout/semantic.mdx`: the `type:` union in its schema block. This is the renderer's own reference page, and it stays: the seven still ship and render. Only its `body` line was corrected, per parameter 3.
- Other hits are listed under Acceptance notes and left alone, per parameter 6.
- `.changeset/`: none. `report-schema.mdx` (`type: 'header'` is a report-section kind) and `user-state-persistence.md` (`type:'nav'` is a favorite kind) are different vocabularies, not hits.
- No skill eval asserts `section`. `skills/objectui/evals/page-builder.json` mentions "sections" only in a prompt; its `must_contain` is `hidden` / `admin` / `card`.

## Skill size readings (`skills/**` diff)

- Changed file `skills/objectui/guides/page-builder.md`: **337 → 342 lines** (+5). One table row was removed, and the landmark pointer the ruling asked for was folded into the existing `box` paragraph.
- Whole package, the sum of every `SKILL.md` under `skills/` (1 file): **137 → 137** (unchanged). The whole `skills/` tree: 5368 → 5373.
- No line ratchet covers the published catalog (`check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` scopes it out deliberately).

## Gates, all on head `91c8cc39a3` (the final commit)

## Tier H

`skills/**` is governed, so this PR stays a **draft**. The seat handles the at-tier review record, the 终稿速读, `needs-user-decision`, and the review request to os-zhuang / hotlong. It lands only after an APPROVED review. This dev requested no reviewers and did not ready the PR.

## Acceptance notes

These were named, not changed: parameter 6 corrects only the files the ruling names.
- `content/docs/components/navigation/header-bar.mdx` authors `type: 'main'` as a JSON block inside an example that also authors the deprecated `type: 'div'`.
- `content/docs/guide/expressions.md` uses `"type": "section"` as the carrier of its `hiddenOn` example.
- Both render, so neither is a failing copy-paste. They are incidental uses that a later docs pass could re-spell to `page:section` / `box`.
- The `SemanticElementSchema` interface docblock in `packages/types/src/layout.ts` says the factory "declares exactly one authoring input, `className`". Since objectui#9910 the registration declares two (`className`, plus the `children` slot; probe `mdx.semantic.inputs`). This is a stale comment, not a contract, and it is not touched here.
- Not measured: whether the app shell already provides a `main` landmark on JSON pages. This is the ruling's own carried confidence gap, and it does not change the letter.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:
  - 七个 HTML 语义分区标签(`article` / `aside` / `footer` / `header` / `main` / `nav` / `section`)在控制台的「精选积木」账本里,从「尚未裁决」改为「已裁决不收」,并逐句写明理由。
  - 发布给客户的建页指南删掉教 `section` 的那一行,改为指向 `page:section` / `page:header` / `page:footer` / `page:sidebar`。
  - `semantic.mdx` 删掉已退役的 `body` 写法。
  - 第二轮(席位采纳复审建议 N1)：指南里指向 `page:*` 的那句补上各自自带的版式。`page:section` 子项间距 `space-y-4`；`page:footer` 上方加分隔线、行内两端对齐、弱化字色；`page:sidebar` 从 `md` 起是固定 20rem 宽的列，不是中性的 `aside`。
- **为什么改**:
  - 执行裁决 5857078807(B)。这七个是 HTML 元素,属于 `kind:'html'` 页面,在那里本来就能渲染。
  - JSON 页面上的地标已由 `page:*` 各有一种拼写承载。
  - 再收一个进精选清单,会给 AI 多一对分不清的近义积木。
  - 实测:真实应用(objectstack 示例、hotcrm)零使用。
- **风险与代价(含回滚)**:
  - 没有公开契约变化:`PUBLIC_BLOCKS`、manifest、类型都不动,七个标签照常渲染、照常通过校验。
  - 代价是客户技能包里少了 `section` 这一行教学。
  - 回滚方式是 revert 本 PR。
- **席位意见**:建议批准。
  - at-tier 契约复审 PASS(`5860159692`)，逐句核对裁决 B 的参数 1–4：账本理由每句为真，`PUBLIC_BLOCKS` / manifest / 类型零改动，指南与 `semantic.mdx` 与渲染器一致。
  - 第二轮只改指南一段(席位在 `containers.tsx` 核对了三处类名)。
  - 未复核项：hotcrm 的零使用读数来自开发者本地克隆，本容器没有 hotcrm，未复测；objectstack 示例与 objectui 示例已由复审复测为零。
  - 裁决自带的置信缺口已有读数：控制台外壳已渲染 `main`(`SidebarInset`)，所以 `page:header` / `page:footer` 在其中不算页面级 banner / contentinfo 地标。「地标」一词沿用裁决原文，不改结论。
- **你要做的**:审阅并批准(`skills/**` 属受管面,需 os-zhuang / hotlong 的 APPROVED 后由席位落地)。
